regimeSub: July CPI at 3.4% in-line kills September hike, weak NFP + soft inflation = extended Fed hold.
themes: July CPI 3.4% YoY (Aug 12) matched consensus after -23K NFP shock → Warsh's hike door closes as rate futures reprice extended hold through Q4; real rates compress to 0.92%
BOK Deputy Gov Yu (Aug 11) confirms August hike despite CPI relief → KRW stuck at 1413 as chip-wage spiral (SK Hynix pay hikes) forces policy divergence from Fed pause narrative
BOJ rate path colliding with Takaichi JGB troubles (Reuters Aug 10) → 10Y UST-JGB spread compression stalls USDJPY at 159.3; Bessent's September nudge loses traction on US softness
OPEC+ September output hike (Aug 2) caps Brent at $88 despite post-Hormuz normalization → energy disinflation finally arriving as gold $4486 holds stagflation premium from Q2 scare
